title: Peter Thiel on "The Portal", Episode #001: "An Era of Stagnation & Universal Institutional Failure."
summary: Peter Thiel is the first guest on Eric Weinstein's The Portal, in a nearly three-hour conversation about technological stagnation, institutional failure and the link between growth and violence. They discuss universities, the economy and the search for a more ambitious future.
why: HN people recommend it as a thought-provoking, wide-ranging case for the stagnation thesis, worth hearing even if you disagree with Thiel.

quote.text: I recommend that people listen to that episode even if it's not interesting to you.
